title: platform-checklist: four REST capabilities are UNCLASSIFIED in coverage.json, so `check:platform-checklist` is red on main
body:
Filed unassigned as an out-of-scope finding from #13788 (symbol-anchor resolver). Not caused by that work — measured on a clean worktree at `origin/main` = `ebb082204d9d7f42017d5846d41bb8ea8cc1ce2c` **before** the first edit, and unchanged by it.

## What is red

```
$ node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs   # exit 1
check-platform-checklist: 4 problem(s)

  ✗ coverage.json · batch_endpoints: UNCLASSIFIED — the platform has this capability (liveness ledger exists) but the checklist neither tests nor waives it.
  ✗ coverage.json · crud_endpoints: UNCLASSIFIED — …
  ✗ coverage.json · metadata_endpoints: UNCLASSIFIED — …
  ✗ coverage.json · route_generation: UNCLASSIFIED — …
```

Four capabilities carry a `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` ledger — the platform has them — while `docs/qa/platform-checklist/coverage.json` neither maps them to checklist items nor waives them with a reason. The gate's UNCLASSIFIED direction is doing exactly its job; what is missing is the authoring.

## Why it went unnoticed

`pnpm check:platform-checklist` is **not CI-wired**, by the standing maintainer decision recorded in `lint.yml` — #11730 (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`) holds that visibility gap. A gate nothing runs per-PR can sit red on `main` indefinitely, which is what happened here: nothing on a PR reports it, so the red is only visible to whoever runs the gate by hand.

## The remedy, and why it is its own card

Either author checklist items covering the four REST capabilities, or record a waiver with a reason for each — the `checklist-author` five-angle capability sweep is the tool for that decision, and it is content work per capability, not a mechanical repair. Deliberately **not** folded into #13788: that card adds a verification surface, and quietly authoring four capability areas inside it would have made both unreviewable.

⚠️ Note for whoever takes this: `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 on `main` today, so a green from it is not the baseline. Measure the error set before and after (`node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs > /tmp/gate.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT=$?"` — capture the code before any pipe) and expect these four to be the whole of it.
